body.purpose: Navigation, forms, search and supporting copy.

shadows.name: brand-lift
shadows.purpose: Brand mark separation from the header.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Caramel action button for publishing, searching and confirming.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c8793d; color: #fffdf9; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 17px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font: 700 14px Outfit, sans-serif; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9d542d; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(57, 126, 156, 0.32); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Quiet paper field for searching by recognition details.
components.html: <label class="ds-input-label">Buscar<input class="ds-input-search" placeholder="Nome, raca ou caracteristica" /></label>
components.css: .ds-input-label { color: #273239; display: grid; gap: 7px; font: 700 12px/1.2 Outfit, sans-serif; } .ds-input-search { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #273239; background: #f6f2eb; border: 1px solid #d9cec0; border-radius: 3px; font: 400 14px Outfit, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease, outline 160ms ease; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { border-color: #397e9c; outline: 3px solid rgba(57, 126, 156, 0.16); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Pet Card
components.description: Photo-led case card that preserves status, place and the next action.
components.html: LobinhaCampinas - SPVer historia completa
components.css: .ds-pet-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #d9cec0; border-radius: 5px; background: #fffdf9; box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(39, 50, 57, 0.08); } .ds-pet-image { height: 160px; background: #e7f1f4; } .ds-pet-copy { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 18px; } .ds-pet-copy strong { color: #273239; font: 700 24px/1 Newsreader, Georgia, serif; } .ds-pet-copy span { color: #667075; font: 400 13px Outfit, sans-serif; } .ds-pet-copy a { color: #9d542d; font: 700 13px Outfit, sans-serif; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky paper navigation with compact active states and a mobile menu.
components.html: Achar seu PetPets perdidos
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 58px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 0 16px; color: #273239; background: rgba(246, 242, 235, 0.93); border-bottom: 1px solid #d9cec0; } .ds-nav strong { font: 700 17px Outfit, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: #667075; padding: 0 10px; min-height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 4px; font: 700 13px Outfit, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav-active { color: #234f4b; background: #dcebe6; }

narrative.overview: Achar seu Pet treats a local search like a living route atlas. Deep blue-green builds trust, caramel marks action, powder blue carries geography and paper neutrals make urgent reading calmer. Newsreader carries meaning while Outfit carries operational precision.
keyCharacteristics: Human copy with privacy by default

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Reserve caramel and marker yellow for actions, status and attention-worthy moments.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Newsreader owns meaning and memory; Outfit owns action and precision.

rules.name: The Layer Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use tone, dividers and composition before increasing elevation.

dos: Keep search and forms aligned to a stable grid.
Use real pet photography where recognition matters.
Respect approximate location and optional contact.
donts: Do not add fictional stats or social proof.
Do not turn status chips into decoration.
Do not expose precise addresses for visual effect.
